target: Production web masoi.yennhi.tech + isolated Release iOS app; one disposable room, 5 players (1 native, 4 shared-device seats)

physicalChecks.case: Lock while lobby changes and roles are dealt from web
physicalChecks.evidence: User confirmed automatic role screen, same session, ready acknowledged; server ready quorum reached 5

physicalChecks.case: Switch to another app while web publishes day
physicalChecks.evidence: User confirmed automatic day update and smooth interaction on return

physicalChecks.case: Force-close app, end game on web, update and reopen
physicalChecks.evidence: User confirmed same room and ended state without re-entering name/code

physicalChecks.case: End-to-end game and identical verdict replay
physicalChecks.evidence: Game reached ended; duplicate request ID did not change server revision; web DOM showed ended

deterministicChecks.case: Foreground while join is busy, server commits but acknowledgment is lost
deterministicChecks.before: Failed: foreground request discarded and manual retry required
deterministicChecks.after: Passed: exactly 2 sends sharing the same request ID, exactly 1 room member

deterministicChecks.case: Old read held across background and foreground
deterministicChecks.result: Passed: new snapshot stays visible after old response returns

deterministicChecks.case: Polling while backgrounded and after return
deterministicChecks.result: Passed: no room reads during inactive interval, immediate restart on return

limits: Physical steps were performed by the user with web/room assertions controlled by the agent; this is not an autonomous native-XCTest pass.
Native XCTest runner never bootstrapped successfully; a later install explicitly hit the free-profile app limit. The created runner was removed.
Controlled lost-ACK and stale-response tests run the shipped iOS bundle with Capacitor web fallbacks and the real room service in isolated RAM, not physical network failures.
Smoothness is the user observation on T21, not a measured FPS, battery or universal-device guarantee.
cleanup: Disposable game ended. Isolated Test app removed; shipping Release updated preserving its data. No web deployment or API contract changes.
